title: Content-Based Recommendations, and the Cosine Similarity Metric

cues.en: It's finally time to start talking about some actual recommendation algorithms.
cues.zh: 終於該開始介紹一些真正的推薦演算法。

cues.en: We're going to start with the most simple approach, recommending items just based on the attributes of those items, themselves, instead of trying to use aggregate user behavior data.
cues.zh: 先從最簡單的方法開始，只根據項目本身的屬性推薦，而不是使用整體使用者行為資料。

cues.en: For example, it can be effective to just recommend movies in the same genre as movies we know somebody enjoys.
cues.zh: 例如，單純推薦與某人喜愛的電影相同類型的電影，也可能有效。

cues.en: Even for more advanced recommender systems that are based on machine learning, baking in some knowledge about the content, itself, can make them even better.
cues.zh: 即使是以機器學習為基礎的進階推薦系統，加入一些內容本身的知識，也能讓效果更好。

cues.en: So, let's think about recommending movies just based on the attributes of the movies, themselves.
cues.zh: 因此，想想如何只根據電影本身的屬性來推薦電影。

cues.en: The MovieLens data set doesn't give us much to work with but one thing it does tell us is which movie genres each movie belongs to.
cues.zh: MovieLens 資料集提供的資訊不多，但確實會告訴我們每部電影屬於哪些類型。

cues.en: For every movie, we're given a list of genres like science fiction, horror, romance, children's, westerns, etc.
cues.zh: 每部電影都有一份可能適用的類型清單，例如科幻、恐怖、愛情、兒童、西部片，

cues.en: that might apply to that movie.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: So, if we know a given user likes science fiction movies, it's reasonable to recommend other science fiction movies to that user.
cues.zh: 因此，已知某位使用者喜歡科幻片，就很合理地可以向他推薦其他科幻片。

cues.en: MovieLens also encodes the year of release into the movie titles, so we can use that information, as well.
cues.zh: MovieLens 的片名也包含上映年份，因此也能使用這項資訊。

cues.en: So, instead of just recommending all science fiction movies to a user who likes science fiction, we can narrow it down further to science fiction movies that were released
cues.zh: 這樣一來，對喜歡科幻片的使用者，不只是推薦所有科幻片，還能進一步縮小範圍，推薦與他喜愛的電影

cues.en: close to the same year as the movies this person liked.
cues.zh: 上映年份接近的科幻片。

cues.en: You could get even fancier and tie each movie in MovieLens to other data sets like IMDB to get information about the directors and actors in each movie, or critic review scores.
cues.zh: 也可以更進一步，將 MovieLens 中每部電影連到 IMDb 等其他資料集，取得導演、演員或影評分數。

cues.en: There are all sorts of attributes about movies at your disposal and this is true for other things you might want to recommend, as well, such as products or music.
cues.zh: 有各式各樣的電影屬性可以運用，其他想推薦的東西也一樣，例如商品或音樂。

cues.en: So, that's a pretty simple example of doing content-based filtering.
cues.zh: 這就是內容式過濾的一個簡單例子。

cues.en: We'll just recommend movies that have similar genres and similar years to the movies each user liked.
cues.zh: 我們只推薦與每位使用者喜愛電影，類型相似、年份接近的電影。

cues.en: Seems reasonable enough but how do we do that, exactly?
cues.zh: 聽起來很合理，但具體怎麼做？

cues.en: Let's start by thinking about how to measure the similarity between two movies just based on their genres.
cues.zh: 先想想，如何只根據類型，衡量兩部電影的相似度。

cues.en: Here's what the raw data from MovieLens looks like.
cues.zh: 這是 MovieLens 原始資料的樣子。

cues.en: For each movie, we're given a piped, delimited list of the genres that apply to that movie.
cues.zh: 每部電影都有一份以直線符號 | 分隔的類型清單。

cues.en: In all, there are 18 different possible genres for every movie, so we can imagine some sort of similarity measure that looks at how many genres any given pair of movies have in common.
cues.zh: 總共有 18 種可能的電影類型，因此可以想像，利用任意兩部電影共有多少類型，作為某種相似度衡量方式。

cues.en: So, what's a good way of doing that mathematically?
cues.zh: 那麼，數學上有什麼好方法？

cues.en: One approach that works really well in a lot of different situations is the cosine similarity metric.
cues.zh: 一種在許多不同情況都很好用的方法，是餘弦相似度。

cues.en: It can be a little bit tough to wrap your head around but once you do, it's really simple, and it's not only applicable to content-based filtering, it's applicable to all sorts of other recommendation approaches, too.
cues.zh: 一開始可能不容易理解，但一旦懂了，就非常簡單；而且不只適用於內容式過濾，也適用於其他各種推薦方法。

cues.en: To make it easier to visualize, imagine we only have two possible genres that every film might belong to.
cues.zh: 為了容易視覺化，假設每部電影可能屬於的類型只有兩種。

cues.en: Comedy and adventure.
cues.zh: 喜劇與冒險。

cues.en: We could then plot every movie on a 2D graph where we assign a value of zero if a movie doesn't belong to a genre and a value of one if it does.
cues.zh: 接著，就能把每部電影畫在二維圖上：不屬於某個類型就設為零，屬於就設為一。

cues.en: So, let's start by plotting Toy Story.
cues.zh: 先來畫《玩具總動員》。

cues.en: It's considered both a comedy and an adventure, so that gives us the coordinates one, one.
cues.zh: 它既是喜劇，也是冒險片，因此座標是 (1, 1)。

cues.en: Let's plot that.
cues.zh: 把它畫出來。

cues.en: Next, let's look at Grumpier Old Men.
cues.zh: 接著看《見色忘友 2》。

cues.en: According to MovieLens, it's a comedy but not an adventure, so that gives us the coordinates one, zero, here.
cues.zh: 根據 MovieLens，它是喜劇，不是冒險片，因此座標是這裡的 (1, 0)。

cues.en: Stay with me.
cues.zh: 繼續跟著我。

cues.en: We can think of these positions as vectors by just drawing a line from the origin of the graph to each movie, like so.
cues.zh: 從圖的原點向每部電影畫一條線，就能把這些位置視為向量，像這樣。

cues.en: Now, look at the angle between these vectors.
cues.zh: 現在看這些向量之間的夾角。

cues.en: That tells us something about how similar these two movies are in terms of their genres.
cues.zh: 它能告訴我們，這兩部電影的類型有多相似。

cues.en: Let's call that angle theta.
cues.zh: 把這個角稱為 θ。

cues.en: In this case, it's 45 degrees.
cues.zh: 這個例子中是 45 度。

cues.en: But 45 degrees isn't a useful similarity metric.
cues.zh: 但 45 度不是實用的相似度指標。

cues.en: Ideally, we wanna measure this between zero and one, where zero means not at all similar and one means totally the same thing.
cues.zh: 理想上，希望衡量範圍在零到一之間，零表示完全不相似，一表示完全相同。

cues.en: Well, it turns out the cosine of that angle does just that.
cues.zh: 而這個角的餘弦，正好能做到。

cues.en: Remember, the cosine of an angle works like this.
cues.zh: 記得，角度的餘弦運作方式是這樣。

cues.en: As theta approaches 90 degrees, it will become zero, and as it approaches zero degrees, it becomes one.
cues.zh: θ 接近 90 度時，餘弦接近零；接近零度時，則接近一。

cues.en: The cosine of 45 degrees is about 0.7, so we could say that the cosine similarity score between Toy Story and Grumpy Old Men is 0.7,
cues.zh: 45 度的餘弦大約是 0.7，因此可以說，《玩具總動員》與《見色忘友》的餘弦相似度是 0.7，

cues.en: based on them both sharing a genre of comedy.
cues.zh: 因為兩者都屬於喜劇。

cues.en: Let's look at a couple of more examples.
cues.zh: 再看幾個例子。

cues.en: Imagine we throw Monty Python and the Holy Grail into the mix, which like Toy Story, is both an adventure and a comedy.
cues.zh: 假設加入《聖杯傳奇》，它與《玩具總動員》一樣，既是冒險片也是喜劇。

cues.en: The angle between it and Grumpier Old Men is 45 degrees, just like Toy Story, so its similarity score to Grumpier Old Men is the cosine of 40 degrees or 0.7.
cues.zh: 它與《見色忘友 2》的夾角，和《玩具總動員》一樣是 45 度，因此相似度就是 40 度的餘弦，也就是 0.7。

cues.en: But what is its similarity to Toy Story?
cues.zh: 但它與《玩具總動員》的相似度呢？

cues.en: Well, it's quiz time.
cues.zh: 來做個小測驗。

cues.en: What's the angle theta between the vectors for Toy Story and Monty Python and the Holy Grail?
cues.zh: 《玩具總動員》與《聖杯傳奇》的向量之間，夾角 θ 是多少？

cues.en: In this case, the vectors for these two movies is exactly the same, so if you said zero degrees, you're right.
cues.zh: 這兩部電影的向量完全相同，因此如果你回答零度，就答對了。

cues.en: There's no angle between them at all because they are identical and the cosine of zero degrees is what?
cues.zh: 因為完全相同，彼此沒有夾角。那零度的餘弦是多少？

cues.en: The cosine of zero is 1.0, which is what we'd expect.
cues.zh: 零度的餘弦是 1.0，符合預期。

cues.en: Since these movies are identical, as far as their genres are concerned, they get a perfect similarity score of 1.0.
cues.zh: 就類型而言，這兩部電影完全相同，因此得到完美的相似度分數 1.0。

cues.en: What if a movie is completely unlike another?
cues.zh: 如果一部電影與另一部完全不同呢？

cues.en: Let's throw in a movie, Indiana Jones, which is an adventure but not a comedy.
cues.zh: 加入《印第安納瓊斯》，它是冒險片，但不是喜劇。

cues.en: So, it has nothing at all in common with Grumpier Old Men, as far as genres are concerned.
cues.zh: 因此，就類型而言，它與《見色忘友 2》完全沒有共通點。

cues.en: What's the angle between Indiana Jones and Grumpier Old Men in this case?
cues.zh: 這時，《印第安納瓊斯》與《見色忘友 2》的夾角是多少？

cues.en: It's 90 degrees and the cosine of 90 degrees is?
cues.zh: 是 90 度，而 90 度的餘弦是？

cues.en: You guessed it, zero.
cues.zh: 猜對了，是零。

cues.en: So, we get a cosine similarity score of zero between Indiana Jones and Grumpier Old Men.
cues.zh: 因此，《印第安納瓊斯》與《見色忘友 2》的餘弦相似度是零。

cues.en: Using the cosine has some other nice mathematical properties, since it's nice and smooth as a function.
cues.zh: 餘弦作為函數平滑連續，因此還有一些不錯的數學性質。

cues.en: There are other ways to measure similarity, too.
cues.zh: 也有其他衡量相似度的方法。

cues.en: For example, euclidean distance just looks at the actual distance between each item as you plot it and Pearson correlation is similar to cosine similarity but it takes the mean values of things into account.
cues.zh: 例如，歐幾里得距離只看項目畫在圖上時，彼此的實際距離；皮爾森相關則類似餘弦相似度，但會考慮平均值。

cues.en: In the case of movie genres, though, cosine similarity is as good a metric as any.
cues.zh: 不過，對電影類型而言，餘弦相似度就是很好的指標。

cues.en: So, how do we scale this up to all 18 genres that we really have?
cues.zh: 那麼，如何擴展到實際的全部 18 種類型？

cues.en: Well, we have to think of each genre as a dimension on that plot.
cues.zh: 必須把每個類型，視為圖上的一個維度。

cues.en: That's right, we need to find the angles between movies and 18-dimensional space, where every dimension represents a movie genre.
cues.zh: 沒錯，要在 18 維空間中，找出電影之間的夾角，每個維度代表一種電影類型。

cues.en: There's no way you can actually picture this in your head, so don't even try, but the concept is exactly the same as it was in our two-genre, two-dimensional space.
cues.zh: 你無法在腦中真正畫出來，也不用嘗試；概念和剛才兩種類型的二維空間完全相同。

cues.en: We plot every movie's position in 18-dimensional space based on its genres and figure out the cosine of the angles between each movie as a measure of their genre-based similarity to each other.
cues.zh: 根據每部電影的類型，畫出它在 18 維空間的位置，再以電影向量之間夾角的餘弦，衡量類型上的相似度。

cues.en: So, try not to think about 18-dimensional space.
cues.zh: 所以，不要試圖想像 18 維空間。

cues.en: Just think of every movie as being described as a set of 18 coordinates, each of which is zero if a movie is not of a given genre, and one if it is.
cues.zh: 只要把每部電影想成一組 18 個座標：不屬於某類型時是零，屬於時是一。

cues.en: For example, Toy Story is an adventure, animation, children's, comedy, and fantasy movie, so if we assign genres to dimensions in the order shown, here, Toy Story has a coordinate of zero, one,
cues.zh: 例如，《玩具總動員》屬於冒險、動畫、兒童、喜劇與奇幻。如果依畫面上的順序，將類型指定給維度，它的座標就是零、一、

cues.en: one, one, one, zero, zero, zero, one, and so forth.
cues.zh: 一、一、一、零、零、零、一，依此類推。

cues.en: That's not hard, right?
cues.zh: 不難，對吧？

cues.en: We can write code to convert those lists of genres into 18-dimensional coordinates pretty easily.
cues.zh: 很容易寫程式，把類型清單轉成 18 維座標。

cues.en: Our next problem is how to compute the cosines between vectors in multidimensional space.
cues.zh: 下一個問題，是如何計算多維空間中，向量之間夾角的餘弦。

cues.en: It turns out that another nice thing about cosines is that this is pretty simple to do, as well.
cues.zh: 餘弦的另一個好處，是這件事也相當簡單。

cues.en: Here's the fancy mathematical equation for how to compute the cosine similarity score between any number of dimensions.
cues.zh: 這是計算任意維度下，餘弦相似度分數的數學公式。

cues.en: Let's break this down.
cues.zh: 來拆解一下。

cues.en: So, go back to our use case.
cues.zh: 回到我們的使用情境。

cues.en: Let's look at the two movies that we want to compute the cosine similarity between.
cues.zh: 看看想計算餘弦相似度的兩部電影。

cues.en: We'll call these two movies X and Y.
cues.zh: 將這兩部電影稱為 X 與 Y。

cues.en: So, the cosine similarity of X and Y is given by this stuff on the right.
cues.zh: X 與 Y 的餘弦相似度，就是右邊這一串。

cues.en: Don't let the notations scare you, it's pretty simple.
cues.zh: 別被符號嚇到，其實很簡單。

cues.en: Let's start at the top of this fraction.
cues.zh: 先看分數的分子。

cues.en: It says to take the sum across I dimensions of the products of X and Y in each dimension.
cues.zh: 它表示，對 i 個維度，將 X 與 Y 在各維度的乘積加總。

cues.en: So, we go through all 18 dimensions, one at a time, looking only have movies that both have data in this dimension.
cues.zh: 因此，依序走訪全部 18 個維度，只看兩部電影在這個維度都有資料的部分。

cues.en: Say we start with the action dimension.
cues.zh: 假設從動作片這個維度開始。

cues.en: We take the product of movies X and Y on the action dimension, then we add in the product of X and Y on the adventure dimension, and so on, and so forth.
cues.zh: 將電影 X 與 Y 在動作維度上的值相乘，再加上冒險維度的乘積，依此類推。

cues.en: On the bottom, we sum up all the squares of each genre dimension for movie X and we sum up all the squares of each movie dimension of movie Y.
cues.zh: 分母則將電影 X 每種類型維度的平方加總，也將電影 Y 每個維度的平方加總。

cues.en: For each, we take the square root of the value we end up with.
cues.zh: 對兩者的結果，分別開平方根。

cues.en: So, by taking the summation of the genre of products between X and Y, and dividing it by the square roots of the summations of the products of each individual movie's genres, squared,
cues.zh: 因此，將 X 與 Y 各類型的乘積加總，除以兩部電影各自類型值平方總和的平方根之乘積，

cues.en: we end up with a cosine similarity score.
cues.zh: 就得到餘弦相似度分數。

cues.en: This is beautiful because it's a sort of algorithm that's easy to code and that computers are very good at doing.
cues.zh: 這很美妙，因為這種演算法容易寫成程式，也很適合電腦運算。

cues.en: In fact, here's the code that actually computes the genre similarity score that we'll be working with, shortly.
cues.zh: 事實上，這就是稍後會使用、實際計算類型相似度分數的程式碼。

cues.en: This function takes in two movie IDs and a dictionary that maps movie IDs to their 18-dimensional coordinates in genre space.
cues.zh: 函數接受兩個電影 ID，以及一個把電影 ID 對應到類型空間中 18 維座標的字典。

cues.en: It just goes through every genre, one at a time, extracts the value of the genre from movies X and Y, and keeps a running sum of X squared, Y squared, and X times Y.
cues.zh: 它依序走訪每種類型，取出電影 X 與 Y 的類型值，持續加總 X 的平方、Y 的平方，以及 X 乘 Y。

cues.en: Then, the cosine similarity is just a matter of putting it all together.
cues.zh: 接著，只要把這些值組合起來，就是餘弦相似度。

cues.en: Note that we simplified the equation in the code a little bit to avoid doing two square roots, since that could be computationally expensive.
cues.zh: 注意，程式碼稍微簡化了公式，避免開兩次平方根，因為運算成本可能較高。
